60800.synopsis:
Xia Xingchi was very poor, until he died and transmigrated into a book to become a young master who was adopted back into a wealthy family, becoming rich in an instant!

At the engagement banquet, the fake young master set up a trap to lure him into fleeing the marriage and making a scene, but didn’t expect that his eyes would light up on the spot as he rushed up excitedly to say, “Hey, husband!”
This appearance like an immortal, this perfect figure with wide shoulders and long legs……the little fortune hunter was disinterested. In his eyes, his fiancé Li Chengyuan was a gleaming humanoid cash machine!
Xia Xingchi resolutely sat on Li Chengyuan’s lap and held his hand affectionately: “Mr. Li, do you believe in love at first sight?”
— Whenever he heard the call of money, he believed.
Everyone was dumbfounded, thinking that Xia Xingchi was truly an idiot, and he was bound to be tossed to the ground by the villainous boss on the spot. Unexpectedly, Li Chengyuan lowered his eyes in silence, and smiled faintly after a moment: “I believe.”
In full view, he picked up Xia Xingchi and abducted him home.
Xia Xingchi was shocked: Wait! Let me go! Your script is wrong!
Facing the derailed plot, the little fortune hunter had no choice but to make money in the entertainment industry to get rich — while giving Li Chengyuan the most loving end-of-life care –

On the day of the blind date, a handsome man arrived. From his looks to his fashion, he perfectly met Shen Xun’s aesthetic standards. So Shen Xun went blank and said, ‘I’m a forensic doctor within the system.’ … Oops, he messed up.

72064.synopsis:

73600.synopsis:

The time she could endure with her terminal condition.

78976.synopsis:
Mo Yu Xin transmigrated into the role of a scummy Alpha in a university campus novel.

By the time Su Yu Bing broke free from the novel’s tragic plot and their baby turned one, Mo Yu Xin finally relaxed. She had altered the story’s painful trajectory, allowing Su Yu Bing to reunite with her destined male lead. Yet, why did her own heart ache with bitterness?  
***
Su Yu Bing learned from a friend that Mo Yu Xin planned to leave Xining City. Panicked, she rushed home to find Mo Yu Xin’s packed luggage.  
Mo Yu Xin explained guiltily, “I’m leaving to earn more for the baby’s needs.”

83840.synopsis:

In this new life, Wen Ning resolved to conceal her identity and mask her true nature. She acted sharp and cynical, feigned superficiality, and pretended ignorance—all the while harboring deep and unchanging love for him. In short, she mirrored his disdain towards her in every conceivable manner.
As anticipated, Pei You abhorred her to the extreme in this life, avoiding her at all cost and retreating ninety li at the sight of her, as if he could scarcely bear to look at her. Wen Ning felt a sense of relief, finally able to select a husband without reservation.
News of Wen Ning’s betrothal spread throughout the city, and on that fateful day, she coincidentally crossed paths with Pei You. Determined to play out the final scene, she clung to his leg, tears welling in her eyes. “Sir, this maiden does not wish to wed. My love for you is unwavering, as clear as day and as evident as the moon and stars. I will marry no one but you in this lifetime!”
In Wen Ning’s script, Pei You should have callously walked away without a second glance. Yet, to her astonishment, he remained motionless. Slowly bending down, his warm fingertips brushed away the tears that had yet to fall from her eyes. His gaze and tone shifted from his usual cold and distant demeanor to a beguiling warmth. “If that’s the case, then marry me. What do you say?”

115584.synopsis:
A soldier of the South Korean special forces, Yoon Seo-yi, died in an explosion during a training session. When she opened her eyes again, she found herself in an unfamiliar world, in the body of Estella Cardeine, a fallen noblewoman.
“Please … Live my life for me.”
At the moment when a dying knight grabbed her hand and begged her to live on, a soul contract was forged. Now, according to the terms of the sacred pact of Cardeine, Yoon Seo-yi’s soul is bound to Estella’s body.
But it’s not easy. Every time she tries to speak in front of others, her words catch in her throat. And only when she closes her eyes and concentrates can she hear a whisper:
“Cardeine’s Blade is not dead… Estella still lives.”
With only her instincts, combat sense, and military knowledge from her previous life, Seo-yi begins to fight back—against a crumbling empire, internal betrayal, and her own fading sense of identity.
This is the story of a soldier reincarnated as a noble lady in a medieval world, leading the fallen Cardeine military to rise once more.

Vanity, materialism, malice, arrogance, selfishness, flattery, meanness, stinginess, and laziness.

Xia Zhizhi, who looks as pure, delicate, and lovely as a white flower, is the epitome of this.

117632.synopsis:
I was a bottom-rung corporate s*ave who died during my third playthrough of a bug-infested RPG—and somehow got reincarnated into the game world. Not just anywhere, but as a disposable mob character in the starter village that gets roasted by demons right at the beginning.
I don’t want to die. So I decided to use every exploit and bug I knew to live freely and selfishly.
But… for some reason, all the harem heroines who were supposed to fall for the protagonist… are starting to fall for me instead?
“Hey, Mobu. Now that it’s just the two of us… what should we do next?”
“Well, Ran, first let’s raid the village warehouse for supplies. Then we can take our time figuring out how we’ll live—just the two of us.”
“You’re so dependable, Mobu.”
“Hey, if you cling to me like that, I can’t walk.”
“Ehehe, sorry…”
…She’s seriously cute. Ran—the main heroine—is already totally into me. With her by my side, I’m going to start over and live a new life in this world.
The blessed protagonist can go walk his golden path, defeat the Demon King and do his hero thing. I’ll do me—take it easy and live however I want.
Sorry, bro. I’m stealing your party. Turns out, everyone likes hanging out with me more anyway.
This is the story of a man who reincarnates as a disposable mob but refuses to give up on life—and ends up breaking the entire worldline by living true to himself.
Fate is something you can change with your own hands.

119424.synopsis:
Office worker Xiao Yingchun gave up and quit her job, choosing instead to return home and inherit her parents’ small supermarket. One day, a young and dashing general walked in through the back door and paid for a box of compressed biscuits—with a silver ingot.
One silver ingot? Worth 6,000 yuan!
From that moment on, Xiao Yingchun’s path to sudden wealth began.
Canned food, biscuits, medicine, makeup—everything could be exchanged for silver!
Forget gold-diggers, spoiled rich kids, and greedy relatives—
She wouldn’t be anyone’s stepping stone, and she definitely won’t marry into a rich family. She will become a rich family herself.
The general slammed his spear into the ground,
“I wish to marry Boss Xiao. Will 100,000 taels of gold do?”
Xiao Yingchun smirked, “How about I give you 10,000 boxes of biscuits, and you marry into my family?”
The general agreed without hesitation, “Deal!”

181120.synopsis:
〈 Imprint 〉
Yuria Rigby, Luke Cunningham’s governess.
She has a secret.
That she is an omega.
She had managed not to be discovered until she finished Luke’s education.
But one day before she was to leave him after everything had ended, a sudden heat cycle came upon her.
Yuria desperately locked the door and blocked off her scent, and Luke ultimately opened the door and smelled it.
“I’m sorry, Teacher. I don’t think I can be an obedient student today.”
After spending a dream-like night together, Yuria disappeared.
Luke decided to find the woman imprinted on his soul.

196480.synopsis:
Lin Jiu transmigrates into the future and receives a bonus: the Fear Collection System.
The original owner of her body was an orphan who had only recently come of age and was burdened with thirty-five years’ worth of student loans, totaling a mere 780,000 credits. Her major was Landscape Machinery and Greening Maintenance.
Lin Jiu: …Never heard of it.
What machinery? What maintenance?
After struggling through a month of work, Lin Jiu returns at night to a government-issued twenty-square-meter apartment on the thirty-seventh floor. The room contains nothing more than a bed, a wardrobe, a desk, and a bathroom. Drinking a sticky discounted nutrient solution that tastes like medicine—snatched up for just 3 star coins—she finally receives her monthly salary of 2,130 star coins at eleven o’clock that night.
The government immediately deducts 2,000 star coins to repay her student loan.
Faced with despair, Lin Jiu realizes that being an uneducated wage worker offers no future. Gritting her teeth, she stares at her gradually dimming system panel and suspects that she simply hasn’t collected enough fear.
In the end, she decides to become a horror game developer.
And she succeeds.
With the help of her system, which allows her to strengthen her mental power through stat allocation, and possessing absolutely no fear of working herself to death, Lin Jiu embarks on her grand horror game enterprise, eventually becoming the nightmare looming over every horror game creator of her era.
From an independent developer to a studio founder, and later the head of a world-renowned horror game company, she expands into horror films, multimedia franchises, and even horror-themed planetary amusement parks.
Years later, historians look back on this age as one overflowing with geniuses and dazzling inspiration.
Countless creators brought their masterpieces in pursuit of the Platinum Hall of Fame, only to discover that they had been born into the same era as its greatest masterpiece:
